A note from Raksina
I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

My current Japanese workplace has a policy that restricts employees from publicly sharing or publishing any work created for the company on an online portfolio, to protect proprietary content and client confidentiality. Therefore, artworks that are able to share on this portfolio under the name of Emerge Clip Co., Ltd will be only non-client works (original content).

However, it is possible to showcase some client projects during a private online interview.

In the meantime, please kindly review my artworks from the previous companies. I greatly appreciate your understanding.

About

Design is my ever-curious seat.

I am a Bangkok-based graphic designer with a background in Interior Design (Assumption University of Thailand) and advanced studies in Graphic Design at Otis College of Art and Design, USA. I thrive on discovering something new at every project.

My work spans graphic design, brand identity, UX/UI, storyboarding, illustration, and photography. I work fluidly across Thai, English, and Japanese — bridging cultures through visual communication.
